# Current hand-proof status — October 29, 2026 UTC

**The entire unique-circle Type I feature of D02.L135 and the entire house ABC three-genuine-root family are now excluded. The whole unique-circle Type III feature remains excluded in both original load alternatives. The unrestricted sharp theorem, equality classification and global prerequisite audit remain open.** PR #11 remains open and draft.

Latest verified head: [`3722e033`](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/commit/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe). Original inventories remain **2373/2513 fine flags checked (140 open); 36/58 coarse rows closed (22 open)**. These complete feature proofs change no original ID, order or flag.

[New adoption and exact scopes](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/ADOPTION_WHOLE_TYPE_I_HOUSE_ABC_AND_UNIFORM_HUB_BRIDGE_THEOREMS_2026_10_29.md) · [Exact checkpoint](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/WHOLE_TYPE_I_HOUSE_ABC_AND_UNIFORM_HUB_BRIDGE_CHECKPOINT_2026_10_29.json) · [Fine roadmap](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/DEEP_GATED_ROADMAP.md) · [Coarse ledger](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/CYCLIC_CELL_LEDGER.md)

## Entire Type I L135, across all physical roof patterns

The [complete original-feature assembly](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/D02_UNIQUE_CIRCLE_TYPE_I_ALL_PHYSICAL_ROOF_FEATURES_COMPLETE_L135_ASSEMBLY_2026_10_29.md) joins all three physical alternatives: zero, one or two positive-length shared roof contacts. A shared contact remains shared when its original mean is an endpoint. Both genuine AD owners, all original angles, full roof/hub/exterior means and positive force ratios are retained.

The [complete mixed-roof proof](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/UNIQUE_CIRCLE_TYPE_I_MIXED_SHARED_SINGLETON_ROOFS_COMPLETE_UNLOADED_EXCLUSION_2026_10_29.md) supplies the last component. Exact full hub moments remove one entire owner. In the remaining owner, a uniform physical support budget gives S<5/9; complete acute-cone and whole-unit projection arguments exclude both original N2 alternatives over the full surviving domain.

A,D retain their entire unloaded true3 stars; V,B,C retain their loaded true2 stars; N is the original unloaded true2 of L135. All nine actual squares remain. In L1345, N is loaded and is not assigned these unloaded equations. Its exact necessary Type I remainder is printed as S, M1, M2 and G with full-data reflections.

The [independent complete assembly review](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/REVIEW_D02_UNIQUE_CIRCLE_TYPE_I_ALL_PHYSICAL_ROOF_FEATURES_COMPLETE_L135_ASSEMBLY_ROOT_TRIANGLES_2026_10_29.md) reconstructs all three full components, the physical join, all twelve entry/component pins and every loaded-N remainder.

## Whole house ABC and all seven direct-root five-body families

The [complete house ABC proof](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/THREE_GENUINE_ROOT_CHAIN_SMALL_SUPPORT_PROPAGATION_AND_COMPLETE_HOUSE_ABC_EXCLUSION_2026_10_29.md) retains original A4/B3/C3/D3/T2 and all three genuine leaves. It covers both physical D alternatives.

- Physically boundary D is excluded by a uniform genuine-root-chain theorem limiting the relevant root to two physical boundary neighbors.
- Physically clear D is unloaded. Its full three-force equation propagates a small support to C. The complete parallel/nonparallel C cover then gives either four actual near-origin units or two actual occupied centers in a rectangle of squared diameter 1−53219/360000.

The new [owned-external-hub nearness theorem](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/UNLOADED_TRIANGLE_HUB_OWNED_EXTERNAL_SUPPORT_TWO_NEAR_NEIGHBORS_FORCE_NEARNESS_2026_10_29.md) is selection-free and permits arbitrary degrees and loads at the neighboring units. It retains every original mean and the closed near-disk endpoints. The [full independent house review](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/REVIEW_THREE_ROOT_SMALL_SUPPORT_PROPAGATION_COMPLETE_HOUSE_ABC_ROOFS_2026_10_29.md) checks the whole support transfer, actual cap geometry and both physical-status joins.

Together with the preceding complete results, the seven direct-three-genuine-root five-body families now have complete exits: both C5 spacings, house ADT/ADB/ABC, and fan H12/H34 and H23. Larger attachment-forest parents still require their exact remaining coverage; C1.5.b3 is not declared closed here. The previous short-path and literal chorded-C6 root results remain accepted.

## Two broad Type II unloaded rows also closed

The [complete perpendicular-owner proof](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/TYPE_II_PERPENDICULAR_HUB_OWNER_WHOLE_UNLOADED_BRIDGE_EXCLUSION_BY_CONTINUOUS_OBLIQUE_GAP_2026_10_29.md) excludes the whole Type II D-perpendicular owner in L135. It joins the prior entire diagonal exit with a continuous whole-unit side gap. The proof includes every original A-side mean, full scalar comparison paths and two exact positive polynomial identities over closed intervals. Capacity supplied a separate complete independent reconstruction.

The [quantitative vertical bridge theorem and full side-return application](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/QUANTITATIVE_VERTICAL_RETURN_BRIDGE_AND_TYPE_II_D_DIRECTION_FULL_SIDE_MEAN_EXCLUSION_2026_10_29.md) excludes the entire D-owned roof-direction exact A-side-mean return in L135. Its generic criterion D(D−a)>2 applies to actual support data at arbitrary endpoint degrees and full means, with the retained initial diagonal-owner convention. Root supplied the separate complete independent review.

**The remaining unique-circle Type II L135 rows are precisely the D-direction far-A-vertex return and the A-only h owner.** The loaded-N Type II cases retain their separate equations and obligations.

## Prior whole Type III and physical-two progress retained

The [complete Type III owner/load assembly](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/D02_BOTH_UNLOADED_HUBS_UNIQUE_CIRCLE_TYPE_III_ALL_ORIGINAL_OWNER_ROWS_COMPLETE_EXCLUSION_2026_10_29.md) still excludes all six original owner alternatives in both L135 and L1345, with the exact shared means, physical masks and individual-zero circle weights. The whole parallel-V2 feature is also excluded in both loads.

The [complete physical-two chain adoption](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/ADOPTION_COMMON_BOUNDARY_ROOT_FAMILIES_AND_COMPLETE_PHYSICAL_TWO_CHAIN_2026_10_29.md) retains its whole adjacent-return, angular, component and force-ratio exclusions. Both physical-two inner-face domains still retain residual work. The development-only continuation note remains explicitly unadopted; no incomplete proposal receives closure credit.

## Verification and precise remaining scope

This latest commit contains seven complete sources, seven separate full independent current-source/application gates, three additional contributor-aware root reconstructions, and the adoption/checkpoint plus current metadata. Root read every new source and review, reconstructed the original joins, checked 33 distinct direct source pins and the exact rational/polynomial records, then verified all 24 changed Git paths and every expected blob. There were no deletions.

Loaded Type I/II, both physical-two residual domains, the two remaining unloaded Type II rows, other positive-chord graph/load families and attachment forests remain. The initial simultaneous common-selection compatibility remains an explicit conditional input in the affected family proofs; the new generic owned-hub theorem itself needs no selection rule. No global compatibility result is silently inferred from local determinant avoidances.

Every argument retains all nine actual squares, original positive forces, true degrees, selected normals, full shared means, physical circle masks and individually zero circle coefficients. Hand proofs only: no Lean/Lake build, CI/workflow dispatch, numerical pose search, angle mesh, new packing certificate or merge.

The complete preceding PR description is preserved in the [description archive](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/3722e033d108293b679a0b23ea05504181e4c3fe/research/nine/PR11_DESCRIPTION_ARCHIVE_AT_71909ADE_2026_10_29.json).
